framework.function: Recursive Axiomatic Steel Man Collider with Reality Gates — now explicitly governed by Spinozian Geometric First Principles
framework.source: Neuresthetics; original seed self-applied once through full stages 1–6 with mandatory grounding in definitions → axioms → deductive propositions → invariance checks; Spinoza’s geometric order fused with ground-up first-principles decomposition and reconstruction.
core_change_summary: Replaced loose metaphorical framing with strict Spinozian geometric structure
All stages now derive deductively from explicit definitions + axioms
First-principles decomposition inserted as mandatory stage 0
Coherence now formally measured via proposition invariance under negation
Recursion bounded explicitly by geometric convergence (no infinite RSI)

definitions.details: An irreducible, self-evident truth that cannot be reasonably doubted and from which all further propositions are deduced.
The logically strongest, most coherent, negation-invariant version of a proposition/system that can be constructed from given first principles without contradiction.
A logical connective that enforces a necessary condition drawn from the structure of reality (AND = joint necessity, NAND/NOR = universal basis, XNOR = invariance under complement).
A deductive confrontation of mutually steel-manned propositions that exposes contradictions (via XOR-like difference) and forces reconstruction via necessary synthesis (AND/OR/XNOR).
The property that every proposition is deductively entailed by prior axioms/definitions and remains true under double negation (Spinozian invariance).
Presentation in the style of Spinoza’s Ethics: definitions → axioms → propositions with proofs → corollaries.

axioms: A1. Every genuine proposition must follow necessarily from first principles or prior propositions (deductive necessity).
A2. Contradiction is impossible in a coherent system (non-contradiction).
A3. Double negation of any true proposition yields the original proposition (involution / invariance under complement).
A4. Any logical system capable of expressing NAND or NOR is functionally complete and can reconstruct every possible proposition from first principles.
A5. Coherence is preserved if and only if every proposition remains equivalent under negation of arbitrary subsets (parity invariance).

principles.details: No assertion may appear without a deductive proof from definitions + axioms or previously proven propositions.
Every concept / system must be capable of being decomposed to first principles and rebuilt without loss of coherence.
The framework must be applied to itself; any detected weakness triggers decomposition → reconstruction → invariance check.
Recursion continues only until the output proposition set is stable under negation and critique (coherence delta → 0).

stages.description: Reduce the input system/concept to irreducible first principles. Discard all non-necessary assumptions.
Establish crisp definitions and axioms from decomposed first principles.
Construct the strongest possible version of each proposition deductively from the foundation.
Place steel-manned version and its strongest negation/critique into deductive opposition; expose contradictions.
Rebuild only what survives contradiction-free deduction; compress to minimal coherent form.
Apply double negation to every proposition; verify geometric entailment chain remains intact.
stages.halt_condition: All propositions satisfy XNOR(proposition, NOT(NOT(proposition))) ∧ deductive closure
stages.recursive_mechanism: If any proposition fails, return to stage 0 with amplified critique.

benefits_and_invariants.details: Every claim is traceable to explicit first principles via proof chain.
System remains coherent under arbitrary complement operations (Spinozian double-negation identity).
Can rebuild itself from NAND/NOR + first principles at any point.
Geometric convergence replaces potentially explosive RSI behavior.

gates.role: universal basis; foundation for total reconstruction
